answer: Continuous Co-Location Attestation. Each agent must periodically submit a signed hardware measurement (TPM quote plus radio-ranging timestamps) proving its compute sits within range of its registered physical anchor. An identity whose attestations drift beyond that range is frozen. The enrollment relic—one uniquely serialized sensor per operator—can only be flashed once; cloning it forces a hardware collision that invalidates every copy at once, so no pearl of shared state survives duplication.
